Schema/context:

Semantic model:
- Cube Addresses (grain: one row per Addresses; primary key: address_id)
  Dimensions: address_id [number, primary_key], line_1 [string], line_2 [string], line_3 [string], city [string], zip_postcode [string], state_province_county [string], country [string], other_address_details [string]
  Measures: count
- Cube Courses (grain: one row per Courses; primary key: course_id)
  Dimensions: course_id [number, primary_key], course_name [string], course_description [string], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
- Cube Departments (grain: one row per Departments; primary key: department_id)
  Dimensions: department_id [number, primary_key], department_name [string], department_description [string], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
- Cube Degree_Programs (grain: one row per Degree_Programs; primary key: degree_program_id)
  Dimensions: degree_program_id [number, primary_key], department_id [number], degree_summary_name [string], degree_summary_description [string], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Degree_Programs.department_id -> Departments.department_id (many_to_one)
- Cube Sections (grain: one row per Sections; primary key: section_id)
  Dimensions: section_id [number, primary_key], course_id [number], section_name [string], section_description [string], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Sections.course_id -> Courses.course_id (many_to_one)
- Cube Semesters (grain: one row per Semesters; primary key: semester_id)
  Dimensions: semester_id [number, primary_key], semester_name [string], semester_description [string], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
- Cube Students (grain: one row per Students; primary key: student_id)
  Dimensions: student_id [number, primary_key], current_address_id [number], permanent_address_id [number], first_name [string], middle_name [string], last_name [string], cell_mobile_number [string], email_address [string], ssn [string], date_first_registered [time], date_left [time], other_student_details [string]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Students.permanent_address_id -> Addresses.address_id (many_to_one), Students.current_address_id -> Addresses.address_id (many_to_one)
- Cube Student_Enrolment (grain: one row per Student_Enrolment; primary key: student_enrolment_id)
  Dimensions: student_enrolment_id [number, primary_key], degree_program_id [number], semester_id [number], student_id [number], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Student_Enrolment.student_id -> Students.student_id (many_to_one), Student_Enrolment.semester_id -> Semesters.semester_id (many_to_one), Student_Enrolment.degree_program_id -> Degree_Programs.degree_program_id (many_to_one)
- Cube Student_Enrolment_Courses (grain: one row per Student_Enrolment_Courses; primary key: student_course_id)
  Dimensions: student_course_id [number, primary_key], course_id [number], student_enrolment_id [number]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Student_Enrolment_Courses.student_enrolment_id -> Student_Enrolment.student_enrolment_id (many_to_one), Student_Enrolment_Courses.course_id -> Courses.course_id (many_to_one)
- Cube Transcripts (grain: one row per Transcripts; primary key: transcript_id)
  Dimensions: transcript_id [number, primary_key], transcript_date [time], other_details [string]
  Measures: count
- Cube Transcript_Contents (grain: one row per Transcript_Contents)
  Dimensions: student_course_id [number], transcript_id [number]
  Measures: count
  Joins: Transcript_Contents.transcript_id -> Transcripts.transcript_id (many_to_one), Transcript_Contents.student_course_id -> Student_Enrolment_Courses.student_course_id (many_to_one)
